blocks.text: Yeh chapter mukhtalif sciencedanon ke pesh kiye gaye nazariyat ke zariye zindagi ke irtiqa (evolution) ka tasawwur pesh karta aur un bare saboot ka jaiza leta hai jin par evolution ka sab se maqbool nazariya qaim hai.

blocks.title: Evolution (irtiqa)
blocks.text: Evolution aabadi ki genetic banawat (alleles ki shareh) mein aane wali naslon ke saath aahista tabdeeli hai jo nayi species banne ka sabab ban sakti hai.

items: Kainaat aur jandar hamesha apni maujooda shakal mein nahi the.
Aaj ke jandar aik saath paida nahi kiye gaye.
Yeh nichli se ooncha shaklon tak be-shumaar tabdeeliyon ka nateeja hain.

blocks.text: Yeh is tasawwur ki ibtidai shakal ke bunyadi khayalat the. Evolution jandaron mein farq (variation) aur natural selection se hota hai: faidamand khasiyaton wale afraad agli naslein paida karne ke liye chune jate, jab ke nuqsandeh khasiyaton wale nahi kar pate, is liye aabadi mein behtar khasiyaton wale afraad ka tanasub barhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Jadeed tareef ke mutabiq aabadi ke evolve hone par kya badalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Us ki genetic banawat, yaani naslon ke saath alleles ki shareh.

items: Evolution: naslon mein alleles ki shareh mein aahista tabdeeli, mumkina taur par nayi species.
Yeh variation aur natural selection se hota hai.
